result.summary: One clear visual defect: the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card displays a missing-image placeholder instead of a restaurant photo.

issues.description: The large image area for Tokumaru Ramen Bar is blank gray with a broken-image icon, unlike the other restaurant cards that display food imagery.
issues.suggestion: Fix the image source or loading failure and display the restaurant photo. Provide an intentional branded fallback if the image is unavailable.
